items.title: Update ProofStory execution plan with ledger sizing and slicing policy
items.context: Add a Ledger Sizing and Story Slicing section, distinguish intent ledger from execution slices, update the lifecycle, schema, milestones, verification matrix, and non-goals accordingly.

happy.desc: The document states that a milestone ledger is an intent-coverage ledger, not an execution plan, and adds ledger sizing/story slicing policy with thresholds.
The M1-M9 plan is updated so oversized ledgers first produce dry-run too-broad/slice-plan diagnostics before any future parent-child orchestration implementation.

edge.desc: The document avoids requiring all milestones to become stories and avoids requiring all stories to run full ProofStory.

adversarial.desc: The document clearly says this docs story does not implement CLI/runtime parent-child orchestration and defers that to later stories.

items.userSees: The final response says: Ledger sizing and story slicing are documented; oversized ledgers now stop before DEV with slice-plan diagnostics, and runtime implementation is deferred.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "milestone ledger is not.*execution|Ledger Sizing And Story Slicing" docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The document now states that the milestone ledger is not an execution plan and includes the Ledger Sizing And Story Slicing section with thresholds.
The M1-M9 plan now routes oversized ledgers through dry-run too_broad and slice_required diagnostics before future enforcement or orchestration.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Do not treat milestone count as story count|Do not turn a parent ledger into one giant checklist|Do not automatically create child Stories" docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The non-goals now prevent milestone count from becoming story count, giant checklist scope, or automatic child Story creation.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Future parent-child orchestration|deliberately future artifacts|MVP should also not add a standalone slicing command" docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The document explicitly defers parent-child orchestration and slicing commands to future stories rather than implementing them in this docs story.

auditLog.reason: Start docs-only edit after PLAN gate passed
Docs updated and committed with ledger sizing/story slicing policy
